summary: Comprehensive backend testing of Consultation Workflow MVP (Feb 2026): admin clinic CRUD, lead-to-clinic auto-create ConsultationRequest, full clinic action lifecycle (assigned -> clinic_viewed -> call_attempted -> booked -> attended), KPI/performance endpoints, strict cross-clinic access control (404 isolation), input validation, and regression on existing admin/blog/leads endpoints. All 25 tests passed (17 spec items + 8 derived sub-tests).
critical_code_review_comments: consultations.py is ~960 lines — approaching the 700-line guideline. Consider splitting admin vs clinic endpoints into separate modules for maintainability.
_iso_diff_seconds returns None on parse failure but datetime.fromisoformat may fail on tz-naive ISO strings stored historically; consider normalising on write.

_send_clinic_assignment_email has an operator-precedence bug: `not RESEND_API_KEY or not clinic.get('notification_email') and not clinic.get('email')` — `and` binds tighter than `or` so the early-return sometimes still runs the email path; works correctly in current happy paths but is fragile. Recommend parentheses.
_backfill_legacy_assigned_leads runs on every list call (cheap but O(N) per request). Acceptable at MVP scale; consider a one-time migration once stable.

Clinic A->B reassignment via /admin/consultation-requests/{id}/assign-clinic does NOT clear/reset clinic_viewed_at or status timestamps from old clinic — could leak progress data when reassigning. Out of MVP scope but worth documenting.
test_credentials: Admin admin@zubite.bg/password; Clinic A mvp-test@example.com/Mvp1234!; Clinic B created dynamically via POST /api/admin/clinics with returned temporary_password.
seed_data_creation: Each test run creates one TEST_Clinic_B_<rand> via admin endpoint plus 3 TEST_Patient_<rand> leads (assigned to A and B) and TEST_RegLead_<rand>. Data uses TEST_ prefix for easy cleanup; not auto-deleted.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Test file at /app/backend/tests/test_consultation_workflow.py is idempotent and self-contained — recreates Clinic B and fresh leads every run. Covers all 17 spec items. If extending: Test 17 has been split (17a invalid clinic_status PATCH, 17b invalid clinic_status POST, 17c book without appointment, 17d invalid action_type). Module-level _state dict carries IDs across ordered tests so don't run tests with -p no:cacheprovider --order random.
